d.t: PVC Re-injectable Hose For Sealing Construction Joints
d.s: SikaFuko Eco-1 is a re-injectable hose for sealing various construction joints in watertight concrete structures. To seal the joint, SikaFuko Eco-1 is injected with suitable Sika Injection materials, such as acrylate and cement suspensions (for multiple injections) or polyurethane resins (for single injection).
a: Multiple re-injections with Sika injection acrylate resins or microfine cement suspensions
One time injectable with Sika injection polyurethane injection resins
Ideal back-up solution for combination with waterstops
Tested in water pressures up to 10 bar (100m)
Suitable for many different structures and construction methods
us: Suitable for many different structures and construction methods where additional joint security/safety is required

Prevents water ingress through concrete joints in the following typical structures: Water retaining or excluding structures, water reservoirs, dams, canals, sewage treatment plants, tunnels, subways, retaining walls
As a back-up system for waterbars

Concrete surface must be clean and all loose materials removed before installing hose and placing concrete.

cp.text: Do not use SikaFuko® Eco-1 for sealing expansion / movement joints.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: SikaFuko® Eco-1 injection hose can also be used in combination with different waterstop profiles: Internally placed expansion joint waterstops, internally placed expansion joint waterstops with lateral steel plates and externally placed expansion joint and construction joint waterstops
